opening.argument: The material presents a conventional in-app promotions flow rather than a guaranteed outcome: the Promotions screen shows a promo-code field, an APPLY control, and an invitation-based free-rides prompt. The accompanying description frames the tutorial around applying promo codes, including the stated distinction between new and existing users. These features place the claim in the context of an ordinary ride-service promotion and reward interface, while the broader promise of unlimited free rides remains unverified.

citations.quote: promo codes are only available for new users but not for existing users
